MEDIUM: no controlled site metrics in V0

Road stroke width is a drawing symbol.
A18 zero is a convention, not an elevation.
D17 OSM says 18 levels; tender says 17.
Library shown is the rebuilt 2016 building.
Plaza OSM polygon includes landscaped area.
Sources S1–S8 and per-object IDs in JSON.
